OCR (taranmış sayfadaki yazıyı tanıma) i:
OCR (recognizing text on scanned pages) requires the free Tesseract program, which is not installed on this computer.

Installation:
1. Download the Windows installer from github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki.
2. During installation, check the languages you need under Additional language data (e.g. Turkish).
3. Close and reopen the program after installing.

If you installed it to a different folder, set the TESSDATA_PREFIX environment variable to ...\Tesseract-OCR\tessdata.
